content.comment_body: Hello, Is there a way to block access to the date and the 9 input/output pages that appear on the [product_name] screen? I've set up a program with multiple custom text screens that navigate well, but when I press the down cursor key on the [product_name], the display switches from my pages to the default date and I/O screens. Pressing the cursor up key brings me back to my screens, but it's somewhat inconvenient. Any suggestions would be appreciated. Thank you.
Unfortunately, it's not possible to disable this feature. Simply pressing the cursor up button keeps you in the standard operating mode of the [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing inconvenience because the [product_name] device shows default date and I/O screens when using the down cursor, interrupting their navigation through custom screens. There's no direct way to prevent or hide these default pages, resulting in disrupted user experience.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want to limit or block access to the default date and I/O pages on the [product_name], so navigation is restricted to only their custom-designed screens.
